defs.d: The process of becoming different.
defs.ex: The product is undergoing a change in order to improve it.

defs.d: Small denominations of money given in exchange for a larger denomination.
defs.ex: Can I get change for this $100 bill please?

defs.d: To become something different.
defs.ex: The tadpole changed into a frog.   Stock prices are constantly changing.

defs.d: To make something into something else.
defs.ex: The fairy changed the frog into a prince.   I had to change the wording of the ad so it would fit.

defs.d: The food and beverage a person or animal consumes.
defs.ex: The diet of the Giant Panda consists mainly of bamboo.

defs.d: A controlled regimen of food and drink, as to gain or lose weight or otherwise influence health.
(of a food or beverage) Containing less fat, salt, sugar, or calories than normal, or claimed to have such.
defs.ex: diet soda

defs.d: Having certain traits subtracted.
defs.ex: You folks reduce it to the bible only as being authoritative, impoverishing the faith. "Christianity Lite", diet Christianity for those who can't handle the Whole Meal.

defs.d: A craft used for transportation of goods, fishing, racing, recreational cruising, or military use on or in the water, propelled by oars or outboard motor or inboard motor or by wind.
A full house.
To travel by boat.
To transport in a boat.
defs.ex: to boat goods

defs.d: An association of members joining together for some common purpose, especially sports or recreation.
A heavy stick intended for use as a weapon or plaything.
To hit with a club.
defs.ex: He clubbed the poor dog.

defs.d: To join together to form a group.
Sufficiently.
defs.ex: Are you man enough to fight me?

defs.d: Fully; quite; used to express slight augmentation of the positive degree, and sometimes equivalent to very.
defs.ex: He is ready enough to accept the offer.

defs.d: A sufficient or adequate number, amount, etc.
defs.ex: Enough of you are here to begin the class.

defs.d: Stop! Don't do that any more!
defs.ex: I'm sick of you complaining! Enough!

defs.d: That which resolves uncertainty; anything that answers the question of "what a given entity is".
Things that are or can be known about a given topic; communicable knowledge of something.
defs.ex: I need some more information about this issue.

defs.d: A female partner in an unmarried romantic relationship.
defs.ex: Marc went to the park with his girlfriend and watched the sunset with her.

defs.d: A female friend.
defs.ex: Mary always enjoyed hanging out with her girlfriend Jessica.

defs.d: A father of someone's parent.
(by extension) A male forefather.
To be, or act as, a grandfather to.
Factually right, correct; factual.
defs.ex: It is a just assessment of the facts.

defs.d: Rationally right, correct.
Only, simply, merely.
defs.ex: He calls it vermilion, but it's just red to me.

defs.d: (sentence adverb) Used to reduce the force of an imperative; simply.
defs.ex: Just follow the directions on the box.

defs.d: Expressing dismay or discontent.
A room or area for preparing food.
Cuisine.
To do kitchen work; to prepare food.
To embellish a basic food; to season, add condiments, etc.
A period into which a year is divided, historically based on the phases of the moon.
defs.ex: July is my favourite month.

defs.d: A period of 30 days, 31 days, or some alternation thereof.
defs.ex: We went on holiday for two months.

defs.d: A shift (scheduled work period) that takes place late in the day or at night.
Near the end of a period of time.
defs.ex: It was late in the evening when we finally arrived.

defs.d: Specifically, near the end of the day.
defs.ex: It was getting late and I was tired.

defs.d: After a deadline has passed, past a designated time.
defs.ex: We drove as fast as we could, but we still arrived late.

defs.d: Formerly, especially in the context of service in a military unit.
defs.ex: Colonel Easterwood, late of the 34th Carbines, was a guest at the dinner party.

defs.d: A (usually self-sustaining) chemical reaction involving the bonding of oxygen with carbon or other fuel, with the production of heat and the presence of flame or smouldering.
An instance of this chemical reaction, especially when intentionally created and maintained in a specific location to a useful end (such as a campfire or a hearth fire).
defs.ex: We sat about the fire singing songs and telling tales.

defs.d: Used to express surprise, shock or amazement.
defs.ex: My, what big teeth you have!

defs.d: A long dowel or plank protruding from the ground; a fencepost; a lightpost.
defs.ex: ram a post into the ground

defs.d: A stud; a two-by-four.
To hang (a notice) in a conspicuous manner for general review.
defs.ex: Post no bills.

defs.d: To hold up to public blame or reproach; to advertise opprobriously; to denounce by public proclamation.
defs.ex: to post someone for cowardice

defs.d: To enrich.
To become rich.
Wealthy: having a lot of money and possessions.
Having an intense fatty or sugary flavour.
defs.ex: a rich dish; rich cream or soup; rich pastry

defs.d: A part of a larger whole, usually in such a form that it is able to be separated from other parts.
defs.ex: I’d like another piece of pie.

defs.d: A single item belonging to a class of similar items
defs.ex: a piece of machinery

defs.d: (usually with together) To assemble (something real or figurative).
defs.ex: These clues allowed us to piece together the solution to the mystery.

defs.d: To make, enlarge, or repair, by the addition of a piece or pieces; to patch; often with out.
defs.ex: to piece a garment

defs.d: Not different or other; not another or others; not different as regards self; selfsame; identical.
defs.ex: Are you the same person who phoned me yesterday?

defs.d: Lacking variety from; indistinguishable.
defs.ex: It took all night to find our hotel room, as we forgot our room number and each door looked the same.

defs.d: The identical thing, ditto.
defs.ex: It's the same everywhere.

defs.d: Something similar, something of the identical type.
defs.ex: She's having apple pie? I'll have the same.   You two are just the same.

defs.d: Indicates the speaker's strong approval or agreement with the previous material.
(with "the") Something certain.
Sure, positive, not doubting.
defs.ex: I was certain of my decision.

defs.d: Determined; resolved.
(with of) Unnamed or undescribed members (of).
defs.ex: There were serious objections to certain of the proposals.

defs.d: To gather together; amass.
defs.ex: Suzanne collected all the papers she had laid out.

defs.d: To get; particularly, get from someone.
defs.ex: A bank collects a monthly payment on a client's new car loan.   A mortgage company collects a monthly payment on a house.

defs.d: To be paid for by the recipient, as a telephone call or a shipment.
defs.ex: It was to be a collect delivery, but no-one was available to pay.

defs.d: With payment due from the recipient.
defs.ex: I had to call collect.

defs.d: The cessation of life and all associated processes; the end of an organism's existence as an entity independent from its environment and its return to an inert, nonliving state.
defs.ex: The death of my grandmother saddened the whole family.

defs.d: (often capitalized) The personification of death as a hooded figure with a scythe; the Grim Reaper. The pronoun he is not the only option, but probably the most traditional one, as it matches with the male grammatical gender of Old English dēaþ, also with cognate German der Tod. The fourth apocalyptic rider (Bible, revelations 6:8) is male θᾰ́νᾰτος (thanatos) in Greek. It has the female name Mors in Latin, but is referred to with male forms qui and eum. The following quotes show this rider on a pale horse is his in the English Bible and she in Peter Gabriel's lyrics.
defs.ex: When death walked in, a chill spread through the room.

defs.d: To gain (success, reward, recognition) through applied effort or work.
defs.ex: You can have the s'mores: you earned them, clearing the walkway of snow so well.

defs.d: To receive payment for work.
defs.ex: He earns seven million dollars a year as CEO.  My bank account is only earning one percent interest.

defs.d: To prefer; to prefer to.
Prior; earlier; former.
More quickly; sooner, earlier.
Used to specify a choice or preference; preferably, in preference to. (Now usually followed by than)
defs.ex: I'd like this one rather than the other one.

defs.d: The desecration of something holy or sacred; defilement, profanation.
The ejaculation of semen outside of sexual intercourse, especially a nocturnal emission.
One of the large bodies of water separating the continents.
Water belonging to an ocean.
defs.ex: The island is surrounded by ocean

defs.d: A woman in the context of her own wedding; one who is going to marry or has just been married.
An object ardently loved.
To make a bride of
Something that is not crooked or bent such as a part of a road or track.
Five cards in sequence.
To straighten.
Not crooked or bent; having a constant direction throughout its length.
(of a path, trajectory, etc.) Direct, undeviating.

A brief, sharp, not particularly loud, relatively high-pitched sound produced by the impact of something small and hard against something hard, such as by the operation of a switch, a lock or a latch, or a finger pressed against the thumb and then released to strike the hand.
defs.ex: I turned the key, the lock gave a click and the door opened;  a click of one’s fingers

defs.d: An ingressive sound made by coarticulating a velar or uvular closure with another closure.
To cause to make a click; to operate (a switch, etc) so that it makes a click.
To press and release (a button on a computer mouse).
The sound of a click.
defs.ex: Click! The door opened.

defs.d: A state in which opposing forces harmonise; equilibrium.
Mental equilibrium; mental health; calmness, a state of remaining clear-headed and unperturbed.
To bring (items) to an equipoise, as the scales of a balance by adjusting the weights.
To make (concepts) agree.
A person or organization against whom one is competing.
A participant in a competition, especially in athletics.
The work involved in performing an activity; exertion.
defs.ex: It took a lot of effort to find a decent-sized, fully-furnished apartment within walking distance of the office.   He made a conscious effort to not appear affected by the stories in the paper.

defs.d: An endeavour.
defs.ex: Although he didn't win any medals, Johnson's effort at the Olympics won over many fans.

defs.d: To make an effort.
To strengthen, fortify or stimulate
What something does or is used for.
A professional or official position.
To have a function.
To carry out a function; to be in action.
Arrangement or relationship; layout.
defs.ex: the lay of the land

defs.d: A share of the profits in a business.
To place down in a position of rest, or in a horizontal position.
defs.ex: A shower of rain lays the dust.

defs.d: To cause to subside or abate.
A mixture of water and soil or fine grained sediment.
A plaster-like mixture used to texture or smooth drywall.
To make muddy or dirty; to apply mud to (something).
To make turbid.
A round or irregular patch on the surface of a thing having a different color, texture etc. and generally round in shape.
defs.ex: The leopard is noted for the spots of color in its fur.

defs.d: A stain or disfiguring mark.
defs.ex: I have tried everything, and I can’t get this spot out.

defs.d: To see, find; to pick out, notice, locate, distinguish or identify.
defs.ex: Try to spot the differences between these two pictures.

defs.d: To loan a small amount of money to someone.
defs.ex: I’ll spot you ten dollars for lunch.

defs.d: Available on the spot; for immediate payment or delivery.
defs.ex: spot wheat; spot cash; a spot contract

defs.d: A machine built to carry out some complex task or group of tasks by physically moving, especially one which can be programmed.
An intelligent mechanical being designed to look like a human or other creature, and usually made from metal.
A specific form or variation of something.
A translation from one language to another.
defs.ex: It's only in the King James Version of the Bible.

defs.d: To keep track of (a file, document, etc.) in a versioning system.
The quality of being confident, not afraid or easily intimidated, but without being incautious or inconsiderate.
defs.ex: It takes a lot of courage to be successful in business.

defs.d: The ability to overcome one's fear, do or live things which one finds frightening.
defs.ex: He plucked up the courage to tell her how he felt.

defs.d: To encourage.
The act of administering; government of public affairs; the service rendered, or duties assumed, in conducting affairs; the conducting of any office or employment; direction.

A body that administers; the executive part of government; the persons collectively who are entrusted with the execution of laws and the superintendence of public affairs; the chief magistrate and his cabinet or council; or the council, or ministry, alone, as in Great Britain.
defs.ex: Successive US administrations have had similar Middle East policies.

defs.d: A change to the text of a document.
A change in the text of a file, a website or the code of software.
To change a text, or a document.
To be the editor of a publication.
defs.ex: He edits the Chronicle.

defs.d: The collective property and liabilities of someone, especially a deceased person.
State; condition.
To give an estate to.
To bestow upon.
(jewelry) Previously owned; secondhand.
defs.ex: an estate diamond; estate jewelry

defs.d: An account of an asserted fact or circumstance; a rumour; a report, especially an idle or malicious story; a piece of gossip or slander; a lie.
defs.ex: Don't tell tales!

defs.d: A rehearsal of what has occurred; narrative; discourse; statement; history; story.
defs.ex: the Canterbury Tales
